title: The Value of Temporary Control for the M/M/1 Queue
summary: In this article, a one-off option for temporary service rate control for the M/M/1 queue is considered. After taking this option, during a single exponentially distributed period, two service rates are available for use. Once service rate control is lost, the system continues with a fixed service rate $μ$. The objective is to minimise the sum of holding costs and service costs. We approximate the expected total saved cost by taking the one-off option, depending on the starting state or starting distribution.
